title: The Course of Gathered Light
summary: A course in drawing loose light into a dense core in the hand and spending it as a lance or a press.

title: A Course in Searing Rays
summary: A course in rays that carry heat and weight so that a thin beam burns and a broad sweep drives a crowd back.

title: Treatise on Refracted Sight
summary: A treatise on bending light round corners and through glass so that the student sees and strikes at an angle.

title: The Healer's Lamp Course
summary: A course in the steady lamp of light that closes wounds and draws poison out of an ally's blood.

title: The Radiant Guard Course
summary: A course in guards of burnished light that turn blows aside and send a flash back at the striker.

title: A Course of Swift Beams
summary: A course in beams loosed in quick runs and steps that follow the beam as it flies.

title: The Purifying Radiance Course
summary: A course in clean white light that burns taint out of the blood and clears a clouded head.
